title: A caring custom meets uncomfortable truth

captions.energy: Preserving a recognised meaning of support

meaning: Your shared values can support care when considerate actions allow an uncomfortable truth about familiar involvement to be acknowledged.
text: Even a treasured custom can stop matching both people’s actual capacities. In the physical position of Anahata, Strength expresses care through gentle actions, restraint of pressure and attention to vulnerability. The Hierophant in energy brings a wish to preserve recognised support’s meaning instead of overlooking an important shared value. The Tower in emotions offers shock at a collapsed familiar certainty. Noticing that a known kind gesture has become heavy may be difficult. Tenderness allows this to be said without turning uncomfortable truth into broken commitment or evidence of a poor relationship.

For example, you usually invite a large group home after every performance. One day it becomes clear that preparations have long been difficult for one person to manage. The other accepts the admission instead of arguing and helps shorten the gathering and remove extras. **Consideration can preserve care’s meaning while breaking an inconvenient appearance.** Support remains in quiet time together although the former picture of hospitality no longer seems compulsory or equally pleasant to both.

A wish to preserve a value can smooth over discovery too quickly because everything is supposedly repaired now. Shock and frustration then have no room. Alternatively, an uncomfortable truth becomes an accusation against the entire shared history. Warmth remains in concrete acknowledgement and available help today. An inconvenient form can end without declaring every earlier evening false or demanding an identical assessment of change immediately.
